Mali.summary: To view this YouTube content, you must enable audience measurement and advertising cookies. An extension in your browser appears to be blocking the video player from loading. To view this content, you must disable or uninstall it .

Mali.title: AES: After the delivery of 7 aircraft to the Malian Armed Forces (FAMA), Goïta turns to the unified force
Mali.summary: Army General Assimi Goïta called for a consolidation of the resources of the Unified Force of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES) during a meeting on 24 November 2026 in Koulouba with senior military officials. In response to security threats, the leader steered his senior officers towards enhanced regional synergy. He also welcomed the progress made on the ground and urged the troops to maintain pressure on the armed groups.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: People deported from Guinea: CECOGEC calls for their identification and registration
Mali.summary: Bamako, 25 November (AMAP) The Centre for Crisis Coordination and Management (CECOGEC) is urging the public, as part of the management of people deported from Guinea, to report any foreign national who has been hired, accommodated or rented by a third party to the nearest Gendarmerie Brigade or Police Station, with a view to identifying and registering them, AMAP learned from a source close to the centre.

Mali.title: Malian Armed and Security Forces: The 24 FAMa hostages released following an operation...
Mali.summary: Malian Armed and Security Forces: The 24 FAMa hostages released following an air-land operation reaffirm their commitment Following their release on Wednesday, 18 November 2026, in the In-Tebezas area near Kidal, the 24 soldiers previously held hostage were received on Monday, 23 November 2026, by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans' Affairs, Major General Oumar DIARRA.

Mali.title: Image Africa Mali: In Tonka, in the Timbuktu region, JNIM orders residents to leave before Friday
Mali.summary: This is the deadline that the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims (JNIM), affiliated with Al-Qaeda, reportedly gave to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region, on Sunday, 22 November, to leave their town before a blockade. A threat that comes after a deadly year for this town in northern Mali. JNIM jihadists issued an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region, on Sunday, 22 November.

Mali.title: COMBATTING VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN: There is still a long way to go
Mali.summary: COMBATTING VIOLENCE AGAINST WOMEN: We still have a long way to go Every year on 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women is celebrated. If this day did not exist, it would have had to be created; so many women, it must be said, are victims of violence of all kinds. .

Mali.title: In Mali, JNIM is terrorising Tonka, and the army is trying to protect the town
Mali.summary: In Mali, JNIM, the Group for the Support of Islam and Muslims, issued an ultimatum last Sunday (25/11) to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the centre of the country, ordering them to leave their town within five days. Since November 2025, Tonka, located in the Timbuktu region, has been the scene of targeted assassinations of civilians accused of supporting the Malian army.

Mali.title: Mali : à Tonka, dans la région de Tombouctou, le JNIM somme les habitants de partir avant vendredi
Mali.summary: tv5monde

Mali.title: Nominations de Diomaye : Qui sont ces 3 colonels promus par le président de la République ?
Mali.summary: Ces promotions relèvent de l'autorité du président de la République, Bassirou Diomaye Faye, chef suprême des armées, et s'inscrivent dans le cadre des promotions au sein de la hiérarchie militaire. Trois colonels des forces armées sénégalaises sont promus au grade de général de brigade à compter du 3 décembre 2026. L’information est contenue dans un communiqué de la Direction de l’information et des relations publiques des armées (DIRPA).

Mali.title: Pertes russes au Mali : la fuite de données qui trahit les fragilités de Moscou au Sahel
Mali.summary: Le piratage de données démographiques russes a révélé qu’au moins 349 hommes de Wagner et d’Africa Corps ont été tués au Mali. Ce bilan, bien supérieur aux estimations, met à mal le narratif de Moscou, et dévoile sa fragilité opérationnelle au Sahel. Les faits.

Mali.title: جبهة أزواد تبدأ استعدادات لإطلاق مواجهة محتملة مع الجيش المالي
Mali.summary: نبّه بيان إلى خطر من اندلاع مواجهات مسلحة خلال الأيام المقبلة دعت أزواد المدنيين إلى الابتعاد مواقع الفيلق الإفريقي أعلنت قيادات في جبهة تحرير أزواد الاستعداد لخوض معارك ومواجهات مع الجيش المالي وقوات الفيلق الأفريقي التي تتبع روسيا في مناطق شمال مالي، بعد التقدم الذي يحققه جيش الأخيرة في المنطقة منذ نجاحه في السيطرة على مدينة كيدال، أبرز مدن شمال مالي بداية شهر أكتوبر/ تشرين الأول الماضي، في أعقاب قرار قوات أزواد الانسحاب التكتيكي من المدينة.

Mali.title: Promotion dans les armées : Trois colonels promus généraux de brigade
Mali.summary: Selon un communiqué de la Direction de l’information et des relations publiques des armées (DIRPA), trois colonels des forces armées sénégalaises ont été promus au grade de général de brigade à compter du 3 décembre 2026. Des nominations qui interviennent dans le cadre des promotions au sein de la hiérarchie militaire sénégalaise. Il s’agit des colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye, directeur général du Centre des hautes études de défense et de sécurité (CHEDS) ; de Thierno Ndour, chef de cabinet du ministre des Forces armées ; et du médecin-colonel Abdou Razack Ndiaye, directeur du Service de santé des armées.

Mali.title: Senegalese Army: Colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye, Thierno Ndour and Professor Abdou Razack Ndiaye promoted to General (DIRPA)
Mali.summary: The Senegalese Army is preparing to welcome three new generals from 3 December 2026. According to the Armed Forces' Directorate of Information and Public Relations (DIRPA), Colonels Amadou Makhtar Ndiaye and Thierno Ndour, as well as Colonel-Physician Professor Abdou Razack Ndiaye, will be promoted to the rank of General. .

Mali.title: Mali : les FAMa neutralisent une dizaine de terroristes
Mali.summary: Les Forces armées maliennes (FAMa) ont annoncé avoir neutralisé au moins une dizaine de combattants terroristes et mis hors d’usage sept motocyclettes lors de frappes menées les 23 et 24 novembre dans plusieurs régions du pays, notamment dans le cadre de la traque des auteurs de l’attaque contre Niono. Dans un communiqué publié mardi, l’État-major général des Armées indique que ces interventions ont été conduites dans le cadre de l’opération Dougoukoloko, avec l’appui de partenaires, à travers des actions de surveillance, de reconnaissance et de frappes ciblées contre des positions de groupes armés.

Mali.title: Mali: The army claims to have killed around ten fighters following the attack on Niono
Mali.summary: The Malian army says it has struck the armed groups that attacked Niono, in the Ségou region, in central Mali. In a statement issued on 25 November 2026, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) carried out strikes on 23 and 24 November in several regions. "These operations resulted in the neutralisation of at least a dozen terrorists and the disabling of seven (07) motorcycles," the General Staff wrote.

Mali.title: Mali: Assimi Goïta brings the high military command together to discuss security priorities
Mali.summary: The Transitional President, Head of State and Supreme Commander of the Armed Forces, Army General Assimi Goïta, chaired a meeting with the Chiefs of Staff and Directors of Services of the Defence and Security Forces on Tuesday, 24 November 2026, at the Koulouba Palace. . This meeting was devoted to assessing the situation of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), strengthening their operational capabilities and defining the strategic directions for national defence.

Mali.title: Guinea: The fight against illegal gold mining extended to the whole country
Mali.summary: The Guinean authorities are expanding their offensive against illegal gold mining. In a joint statement issued on 23 November 2026 in Conakry, six ministries announced that the operations, which were launched in the Siguiri region, are now being extended to the entire country. .

Mali.title: الطوراق استعملوها ضد الروس على حدود مالي مع الجزائر… مسيرات رخيصة تغير قواعد القتال لصالح المتمردين في أفريقيا منذ 3 ساعات
Mali.summary: داكار: تنحرف طائرة مسيرة ملغومة رباعية المراوح بشدة وتستهدف مركبة عسكرية روسية ثم تنقض عليها لتدميرها، وتحوم مسيرة أخرى فوق مطار، وتخطئ ضربة بفارق ضئيل نفاثة لكنها تصيب ثلاثة رجال قيل إنهم روس. وصارت مقاطع فيديو تظهر فيها طائرات تنقل إلى مشغليها صورا مباشرة لما تراه كاميراتها أثناء استهداف قوات روسية مشهدا مألوفا مع استمرار الحرب في أوكرانيا. لكن هذه المقاطع ليست من أوكرانيا، بل من مالي التي تبعد عنها خمسة آلاف كيلومتر عند أطراف الصحراء الكبرى.

Mali.title: Attack in Niono: FAMa are tracking down the attackers, with around ten terrorists neutralised
Mali.summary: Niono attack: FAMa hunt down the attackers, around ten terrorists neutralised Operation Dougoukoloko saw FAMa and their partners carry out airstrikes in several Malian regions on 23 and 24 November 2026. In particular, they are continuing to hunt down the perpetrators of the attack on Niono. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, at least a dozen terrorists have been neutralised and seven motorbikes have been put out of use.

Mali.title: Mali: "Support for Islam and Muslims" gives Tonka residents two days to leave and threatens to impose a siege
Mali.summary: on the squares

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa neutralise...
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) neutralise several terrorists and destroy logistical resources in various regions. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are continuing their operations to secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. .

Mali.title: Road safety: Dièma Police Station arrests a suspect in an armed robbery on the Dièma–Kayes road
Mali.summary: The vigilance of the police services enabled a further intervention on the Dièma-Kayes road. On 19 November 2026, the Dièma Police Station, led by Police Commissioner Djibril SANOU, arrested an individual suspected of being involved in an armed robbery, as part of the security operations initiated by Chief Police Superintendent Ousmane DIALLO, Regional Director of the National Police of Nioro du Sahel.

Mali.title: FAMa strikes in Nioro, Niono, Tonka, Debelin, Kidal, Dandougou and Sofara: several terrorists neutralised
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On 23 and 24 November 2023, the FAMa carried out a series of strikes in several regions of the country, in particular continuing the hunt for the perpetrators of the attack on Niono.

Mali.title: Niono: The hospital is treating the injured despite the damage
Mali.summary: CURRENTLY On 21 November, teams from Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) and their colleagues from the Ministry of Health treated 26 injured people in Niono, in the Ségou region. They were working in a facility that was itself affected during the clashes. MSF reports two deaths during the violence that took place that day in Niono and Arabébé, near Niafounké, including a member of the healthcare staff.

Mali.title: Diéma–Kayes road: Suspected robber arrested near Madina
Mali.summary: Axe Dièma-Kayes : un braqueur présumé arrêté près de Madina Le commissariat de police de Dièma a arrêté, le 19 novembre 2026, un jeune homme de 26 ans soupçonné de braquages sur l'axe Dièma-Kayes. Identifié par les initiales A.S., il a été interpellé près du village de Madina, après plusieurs signalements d'attaques sur cette route. Selon les enquêteurs, le suspect agissait avec un complice.

Mali.title: Terrorist attack in Niono and strike in higher education: The CNDH-Mali calls for the protection of civilians and for social dialogue
Mali.summary: On 24 November 2026, the National Human Rights Commission (CNDH) issued two press releases, one on the attacks on civilian targets in Niono and the other on the indefinite strike by higher education and scientific research lecturers. In these two statements, the Commission calls for the protection of fundamental rights, the accountability of the stakeholders concerned, and dialogue.

Mali.title: Mali: JNIM jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonk
Mali.summary: In Mali, the al-Qaeda-linked Jnim is giving the inhabitants of Tonka until Friday to leave the town, after which this locality in the Timbuktu region will be placed under blockade. The jihadists are reacting to the deployment in the town of a detachment of the Malian army and its Russian partners from the Africa Corps. In the space of a year, JNIM has murdered several civilians in Tonka for their supposed links to the army.

Mali.title: Mali: Près de 350 combattants russes tués en trois ans, selon une enquête du Guardian
Mali.summary: Près de 350 combattants russes ont perdu la vie au Mali entre septembre 2023 et septembre 2026, selon des données de l'agence nationale russe des statistiques (Rosstat), obtenues par deux groupes de hackers, Cyber Partisans et Silent Crow, et analysées par le quotidien britannique The Guardian. Le journal indique avoir pu associer la majorité des décès recensés à des affrontements connus.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: 34 terrorists neutralised and significant logistical resources destroyed by FAMa
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the nation that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Between 20 and 23 November 2026, the FAMa carried out a series of strikes against the logistical assets of armed terrorist groups.

Mali.title: Mali: Jnim jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region
Mali.summary: The voice messages were broadcast on Sunday, in several national languages: the JNIM is giving the inhabitants of Tonka who wish to leave five days, up to and including Friday, to do so. After this date, the jihadists are threatening to prevent all vehicles from entering or leaving the town. Even canoes will no longer be "allowed" to dock there.

Mali.title: Mali: JNIM jihadists issue an ultimatum to the inhabitants of Tonka, in the Timbuktu region
Mali.summary: In Mali, Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda, has given the inhabitants of Tonka until Friday to leave the town, after which this locality in the Timbuktu region will be placed under blockade. The jihadists are reacting to the deployment in the town of a detachment of the Malian army and its Russian partners from the Africa Corps. .

Mali.title: Koulouba: Assimi Goïta meets with the military command
Mali.summary: Cette rencontre intervient dans un contexte marqué par des défis sécuritaires importants d’où les orientations du Chef suprême des Armées pour consolider la montée en puissance des FAMa et accroitre leur efficacité sur le terrain. Plusieurs chefs militaires étaient autour du président de la Transition non moins ministre de la Défense pour la circonstance. L’objectif affiché étant d’évaluer les forces armées et de sécurité, de renforcer la cohérence du commandement militaire et de définir les priorités stratégiques et opérationnelles.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: Over 3,000 VDPs set to benefit from a training programme for their professional retraining
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso: More than 3,000 VDPs soon to benefit from a training programme for their professional retraining In recognition of the commitment of the Volunteers for the Defence of the Homeland (VDP), an agreement has been signed between Burkina Suudu Bawdè (the House of Skills of Burkina Faso) and the Brigade of Volunteers for the Defence of the Homeland (BVDP).

Niger.title: General mobilisation for the defence of the homeland: NGOs and CSOs made aware of their responsibility
Niger.summary: On Tuesday, 24 November 2020, the Commission responsible for organising, preparing and monitoring the implementation of the general mobilisation for the defence of the homeland (COMOG) met with the heads of non-governmental organisations and stakeholders from Nigerien civil society. The aim is to enable these organisations to take ownership of the concept and implications of general mobilisation, but also to educate them about their role as intermediaries through awareness-raising activities.

Niger.title: Niger: The expulsion of the Mahamid community reignites tensions with Chad following accusations of interference
Niger.summary: The Chadian government has criticised the order issued by Niamey to the Mahamid community, Arab pastoralists who have been settled in the Diffa region for decades. Gassim Chérif Mahamat, its spokesperson, stated on 24 November that these people are Nigerien nationals and not foreigners who can be deported without due process. "Niger cannot trample on international law," he declared.

Niger.title: Saudi national kidnapped by suspected Islamic State militants in Niger, sources say
Sahel : un Saoudien aurait été enlevé au Niger puis transféré au Mali
Niger.summary: Un étranger présumé de nationalité saoudienne aurait été enlevé au Niger dans la nuit du 21 novembre. Plusieurs médias spécialisés en font état, mais ni Niamey ni Riyad n’ont confirmé. Selon le journaliste de France 24 Serge Daniel, qui s’exprime sur X « d’après ses informations », la victime aurait été emmenée dans la région de Ménaka, au nord du Mali.

Niger.title: Agadez: The Governor chairs a regular meeting of the Regional Security Council (RSC)
Niger.summary: Agadez, 25 November (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) on Wednesday, 25 November 2026, in the Governor's Office meeting room. Several items were on the agenda for this meeting, including an assessment of the security situation in the region and various other matters.

Niger.title: Attackers kill 11 Niger soldiers in Diffa region
Niger.summary: FILE: Nigerien special forces secure the Iferouane area during the Festival de l’Aïr in Niger, December 2, 2022. /VCG Boko Haram fighters on Tuesday, November 24, attacked a patrol in southeast Niger, killing 11 soldiers and wounding five others, the defense ministry said in a statement. The attack occurred near the village of Baroua in the Diffa region, it said.

Niger.title: Lutte contre la criminalité à Zinder : six récidivistes, dont une femme, arrêtés pour au moins cinq vols commis moins d’un an après leur sortie de prison
Niger.summary: Un réseau criminel de six individus, dont une femme, spécialisé dans les cambriolages nocturnes, les vols par effraction et le recel, a été démantelé par le Service interrégional de la Police judiciaire de Zinder (SIRPJ/Zr). Interpellés à la suite d’une opération menée dans la nuit du 17 au 18 novembre 2026 au quartier Jaguindi, les suspects, tous de nationalité nigérienne et âgés de 30 à 77 ans, ont reconnu avoir commis au moins cinq vols depuis leur sortie de prison, il y a moins d’un an.
